Only index.bundle is fetched; no runtime exception captured, but app stays on Metro bundling toast without mounting visible navigation/UI.

Harden withCarPlayScenes AppDelegate patching against multiline startReactNative signatures where closing ')' is on same line as launchOptions parameter.
Re-run isolated clean prebuild and assert generated AppDelegate matches intended manual file semantics (including Siri/deep-link forwarding behavior).
Continue runtime investigation for web blocker by instrumenting expo-router lazy module resolution path for app/_layout (currently no visible JS exception but mount never happens).
critical_code_review_comments: CLEAN iOS prebuild generated AppDelegate differs from repository AppDelegate and regresses startup architecture. This is a generation correctness bug, not just manual-file drift.
withCarPlayScenes regex used to strip factory.startReactNative is brittle against current generated formatting (closing parenthesis can be inline with launchOptions argument).
Idempotency checks passed for Info.plist, bridging header, and pbxproj across two iOS prebuild runs (hash diff empty).
AdMob meta-data keys remained unique after repeated Android prebuild (no duplicate com.google.android.gms.ads.* keys).
TypeScript status: /tmp/megaradio-tsc-now.log equals /tmp/megaradio-tsc-after.log (no newly regressed diagnostics introduced in this run).
remoteLog.ts still hardcodes endpoint/API key instead of env-based config; this violates env-only credential rule and should be reviewed separately.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use isolated temp project workflow (not /app/frontend/ios) to validate clean generation: rsync frontend excluding root ios/android, symlink node_modules, run expo prebuild --platform ios --clean, then inspect generated ios/MegaRadio/AppDelegate.swift for any factory.startReactNative calls. rca_of_issue: RCA-1 (clean prebuild regression): withCarPlayScenes AppDelegate patch relies on regex that expects a standalone ')' line for startReactNative block; current generated AppDelegate keeps closing ')' inline with launchOptions parameter, so block is not removed during clean generation. Repro: run clean iOS prebuild in isolated temp project and inspect generated ios/MegaRadio/AppDelegate.swift lines containing factory.startReactNative. RCA-2 (preview blocker): app boots index.bundle and logs startup modules, but UI remains on bundling overlay; no request failure except Cloudflare RUM abort and no unhandledrejection/pageerror captured, indicating unresolved lazy route/module mount path still unproven.
